title: macOS CoreAudio discovery slice
description:
Keep a minimal native macOS backend for: device enumeration, device names, supported input/output config ranges, default input/output config.

Goals:
- Deterministic, testable surface
- Clear error mapping (OSStatus -> error variants)
- Non-native targets build with stubs

title: Reduce panics in macOS wbtests
description: Replace unconditional panic branches in macos/*_wbtest.mbt with explicit invariant checks or tolerant assertions (e.g. handle Unknown buffer size where it can happen; treat missing devices as OK). Goal: tests should fail only on real regressions, not environment quirks.

title: macOS error mapping parity
description:
Improve DefaultStreamConfigError/CoreAudioError mapping from OSStatus where feasible:
- Map kAudioHardwareBadDeviceError / kAudioHardwareNotRunningError etc to DeviceNotAvailable
- Map format unsupported errors to StreamTypeNotSupported

Keep BackendSpecific(op, status) as fallback.

title: Project hygiene (bd/CI/docs)
description: Repository-level work: bd issue workflow, CI for MoonBit targets, docs parity notes, and release hygiene.

title: CI: run moon test on core + macOS
description:
Add GitHub Actions:
- ubuntu-latest: run Total tests: 4, passed: 4, failed: 0. (pure core only)
- macos-latest: run Total tests: 8, passed: 8, failed: 0. (includes macos package tests)
Optionally also run  for faster feedback.

title: Install bd git hooks
description:
Run ✓ Git hooks installed successfully

Installed hooks:
  - post-checkout
  - prepare-commit-msg
  - pre-commit
  - post-merge
  - pre-push so issues.jsonl stays in sync and merge driver is active for .beads/*.jsonl.

title: Initial commit + push scaffold
description:
Repo currently has no commits. Create the initial commit containing:
- MoonBit packages + tests
- README/UPSTREAM/AGENTS
- bd issue JSONL + .gitattributes
Then  to origin.

title: Pure core parity (types/heuristics/time)
description:
Port and maintain the deterministic, portable subset of RustAudio/cpal pinned in UPSTREAM.md.

Scope:
- cpal-like core types (StreamConfig, SupportedStreamConfig*, buffer size, sample rates)
- heuristics for default config selection
- StreamInstant/Duration timestamp arithmetic
- SampleFormat helpers

Non-goals (for this epic): platform audio backends beyond deterministic discovery.

title: SupportedStreamConfigRange sample-rate helpers
description:
Add API parity for:
- SupportedStreamConfigRange::with_sample_rate(sample_rate) -> SupportedStreamConfig (panics on out-of-range, like upstream)
- SupportedStreamConfigRange::try_with_sample_rate(sample_rate) -> SupportedStreamConfig?
- SupportedStreamConfigRange::with_max_sample_rate() -> SupportedStreamConfig

Then add MoonBit tests that lock the behavior (range check + buffer_size passthrough + sample_format passthrough).

title: Audit upstream core API surface vs MoonBit
description: From pinned commit in cpal-reference, list which pure-core items are already ported and which are missing (types, methods, constants). Output as a short checklist in a tracked doc (e.g. CORE_PARITY.md) with links to upstream paths/lines.
notes: Added CORE_PARITY.md checklist (ported/missing/out-of-scope) against pinned upstream commit.

title: Timestamp callback info types
description:
Port cpal core timestamp structs from upstream lib.rs:
- InputStreamTimestamp / OutputStreamTimestamp (capture callback/stream instants)
- InputCallbackInfo / OutputCallbackInfo wrappers

Keep them pure-data + deterministic. Add tests for basic constructors/accessors and StreamInstant interactions.

title: CPAL full port (end-to-end)
description:
Goal: complete MoonBit implementation of RustAudio/cpal (pinned by UPSTREAM.md) including public API surface, stream building/IO, and platform backends.

Strategy: port upstream tests/behavior vectors first, then implement incrementally until green.

title: Core public API (HostId/DeviceId/traits/errors)
description: Port the public surface needed for cross-platform code: HostId/DeviceId, error model, and trait-like Host/Device/Stream APIs. Keep deterministic parts fully tested.

title: Core API spec skeleton
description: Add spec.mbt with declaration-only stubs for Host/Device/Stream surface to guide incremental implementation. Keep implementation in separate files.

title: DeviceId + parsing
description: Port DeviceId (HostId + String) with Display/FromStr-like helpers, and DeviceIdError. Add tests for parsing, formatting, and error cases.

title: Null backend scaffold
description: Implement a Null host backend that compiles on all targets and returns empty devices; streams are no-op or return errors. This keeps the full API usable for tests on CI.
notes: Added new package zhengyu/moon_cpal/null with Null Host/Device and tests.

title: Dynamic host/device wrappers
description: Add dynamically-dispatched Host/Device/Stream types (similar to upstream platform::Host) so users can switch backends at runtime. Start with CoreAudio + Null.
notes: Added new package zhengyu/moon_cpal/platform with dynamic Host/Device wrappers for Null + CoreAudio (best-effort, error-tolerant). Also adjusted HostId to pub(all) so subpackages can construct variants.

title: HostId + HostUnavailable
description: Port HostId list and string roundtrip + parse errors. Provide available_hosts for current target (initially: native -> CoreAudio, wasm -> Null). Add tests.
notes: Implemented HostId + HostUnavailable + available_hosts (native vs non-native) and tests.

title: Shared error types (BackendSpecific/DefaultStreamConfig/etc)
description: Port core error types from upstream cpal/error.rs into the root package and refactor existing macos package to use them instead of backend-local errors where applicable.
notes: Added cpal_error.mbt (BackendSpecificError + DefaultStreamConfigError + SupportedStreamConfigsError) and refactored macos package to raise root DefaultStreamConfigError via helper constructors.

title: Error parity expansion (BuildStream/Play/Pause/Stream)
description: Port remaining core error enums from upstream error.rs: BuildStreamError, PlayStreamError, PauseStreamError, StreamError (with BackendSpecificError). Add minimal helper constructors as needed for cross-package backends.
notes: Extended cpal_error.mbt with BuildStreamError/PlayStreamError/PauseStreamError/StreamError and added helper constructors + tests.

title: Data + sample layer
description: Implement Data buffer abstraction and sample conversion layer (Sample/FromSample/SizedSample, I24/U24) with tests. This unlocks raw/typed stream callbacks.

title: CoreAudio streams (macOS)
description: Implement build_input_stream/build_output_stream for CoreAudio on macOS native target, including play/pause/Drop semantics and timestamping.

title: Upstream test inventory
description: Enumerate upstream test files and map them to MoonBit test files; add missing tests as skipped initially where platform-specific.

title: Other backends (stubs then implementations)
description: Add non-macOS backends. Start with compiling stubs that satisfy the API, then implement real backends (ALSA/WASAPI/etc) as follow-ups.
